g.text: The full xi function evaluates every coefficient. No finite zero list replaces the tail.
Sylvester’s criterion proves positive definiteness through degree eight at each displayed pole.
These determinants are basis-dependent; the plot makes no comparison of metric conditioning.
The unrestricted degree criterion remains MP16–18. No RH conclusion follows from these finite tests.
